name: FinML-Chain
description: Transaction Fee Mechanisms (TFMs) are critical for blockchain resource allocation. Ethereum’s EIP-1559 improved fee estimation via dynamic base fees; however, its reactive design adjusts fees based only on past transactions, limiting proactive optimization. We introduce a novel research setting applying machine learning to proactive TFM design under EIP-1559, enabled by FinML-Chain, an open-access, multi-modal dataset integrating high-frequency on-chain transactions with low-frequency social media discussions. We benchmark linear regression, DNN, XGBoost, and LSTM for next-block gas prediction, identifying DNNs as most robust, and extend this model with monotonicity constraints and BERT-based feature engineering to enhance interpretability. This work contributes: (1) a novel research setting for ML-driven proactive TFM design; (2) an open-access, multi-modal dataset for reproducible blockchain AI research; (3) a comprehensive ML benchmark for gas usage prediction; and (4) interpretable AI enhancements via monotonicity constraints and BERT-based feature engineering.
